# Wise

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Money-transfer marketing and signed-out login: bright green #9FE870 pills on forest #163300, white page, Wise Sans headlines, Inter body, 10px login fields..

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Public marketing pages and the login wall only. Email and password fields were left empty. No account, phone, card, bank details, or KYC was entered. No transfer was started. Google, Facebook, Apple, and passkey were not clicked.. Themes: light.

Public marketing pages and the signed-out login of wise.com, read on 2026-11-19. Surfaces: `/` (title resolved as Wise Singapore), `/sg/pricing/`, and `/login`. Signed out. Light only (`html.np-theme-personal`, `color-scheme: normal`). Viewport was the preview pane at 1169 by 731 CSS pixels, devicePixelRatio 2. No account was created. The email and password fields were left empty. No phone, card, bank details, or KYC was entered. No transfer was started.

## Typography

9 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Inter, Wise Sans.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Wise Sans is Wise's display face, named by `--eds-font-family-display` and computed on the home h1. Inter is the text face, with Vazirmatn, Noto Sans SC, Zen Kaku Gothic Antique, Noto Sans KR, Noto Sans Thai, Noto Sans Hebrew, then Helvetica, Arial, and sans-serif. The files are not in this package. The tokens name the stacks and fall back to Inter and Helvetica.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Headline sizes are fluid. 85.909px and 77.947px are what the browser computed at innerWidth 1169, not a 1440 layout. Three-decimal rounding is marked on those tokens.

`light.color.border`, `light.color.neutral-fill`, and `light.color.calculator-fill` are alpha colours flattened onto white so the token checker can store a hex. The computed rgba is in [raw/measurements.md](raw/measurements.md).

Hover colours declared as `--color-interactive-accent-hover` and `--color-interactive-primary-hover` were not confirmed on a hovered element, so they are not tokens. Focusing the empty email field did not change its inset ring.

`color-scheme` was `normal`. There is no dark set. Bright orange, yellow, pink, blue, and dark purple are resolved custom properties. They were not confirmed as a paint on these three pages.

Motion durations are computed and declared values. `prefers-reduced-motion` was not emulated.

No screenshot backs these numbers.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the measured green and forest.** The primary face is `light.color.accent` with `light.color.on-accent`. On a green plate the same button inverts to `light.color.forest` with `light.color.on-forest`. Readings are in [raw/measurements.md](raw/measurements.md).
- **Use the pill for a marketing action.** Large actions are 48px, radius `core.radius.pill`. The nav Sign up is 32px. The login field is the exception: radius `core.radius.input`.
- **Keep the login fields empty in any reconstruction of this capture.** The email and password controls were measured blank. No address was entered.
- **Stop at the login wall.** Google, Facebook, Apple, passkey, recovery, and signup were not followed. Do not invent the register form.
- **Do not invent a dark theme.** These pages painted `np-theme-personal` only.
- **Do not treat the 1169px headline sizes as a desktop token for every width.** They are the fluid computed size at this viewport.
